test_title: PYST 9: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The students / have been / doing yoga / since an hour
solution:
The erroneous part is **‘since an hour’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the present perfect continuous tense.
 
• The portion of the sentence ‘since an hour’ is grammatically wrong.
 
 
• ‘Since’ is a preposition that refers to a previous point in time. It is generally used in present perfect or past perfect tenses.
 
 
 
• The correct preposition to be used here is ‘for’ in place of ‘since’. Here ‘for an hour’ refers to the period of time for which the students have been practising.

**The sentence after correction is: ***‘The students have been doing yoga for an hour’.*
